title: Amplified-machine configuration
statement: Given a finite nondeterministic machine $N$ with $k$ work tapes, a repetition count $r$, and a Boolean input string $x$, an amplified configuration is a configuration on the input $x$ with $(r+1)k$ work tapes and phase states of the form run, rewind, or seek, indexed by run numbers in $	ext{Fin}(r+1)$ and counters in $	ext{Fin}(r+2)$.
